title: Contagious (Complete)
reward_mail_body: Hello. The San Paro Health Authority would like to advise all residents of San Paro that the recent infection spreading amongst the community has mutated into a new form. This new strain is far more virulent than the previous version and infected individuals are finding themselves in possession of the Agrotech Close Engagement System, or ACES for short. We’re currently researching a cure for this Mutation but suggest in the meantime that you continue as you would do normally. Kill members of the opposite faction with the attached ACES to help us research the mutation. Thank you and Good Health.

reward_mail_body: Your enemies will be smitten every time you use this Low-Cyclic Love-Gun. Have one on us, Valentine.

title: Someone's Favourite - Rank 4 (Complete)
reward_mail_body: Well, you've done it. You have broken some hearts. You may have been someone's favourite Now, you're left only with Heartache. I hope you know you've earned it.

title: Valentine's Week Massacre - Rank 1
reward_mail_subject: Valentine's: Love is in the air.
reward_mail_body: To start your journey in this Valentine's event, you should set the mood with some Romantic music. Attached is an example you can use as a death theme.

title: Valentine's Week Massacre - Rank 2
reward_mail_body: Looking sharp is important, but if you can't manage that, at least make them laugh. These customizable glasses are bound to melt your loved-one's heart, or at least get a chuckle.

title: Valentine's Week Massacre - Rank 3
reward_mail_body: A funky death theme to show off your moves, this music is perfect for when a man shows up at the door with a large pizza, extra sausage.

title: Valentine's Week Massacre - Rank 4
reward_mail_body: The path of true love never did run smooth, and in San Paro your average lovers tiff results in several destroyed vehicles and thousands of dollars worth of property damage. To help you settle your differences, we’re sending you a leased M1922 Tommy Gun and a non-faction locked preset Police-hat for when it’s time to call in the Love Police.

title: Valentine's Week Massacre - Rank 5 (Complete)
reward_mail_subject: Valentine's: I've got you under my skin.
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on completing the Valentine’s Week Massacre event! For your final reward we have awarded you a Casanova title for your character and a Valentine’s weapon skin that you can apply to your weapons.

title: Snubby Love - Rank 1
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on reaching level 1 in the Snubby Love role! The Colby SNR really proves that it’s not what you’ve got but what you do with it that counts. As a reward, we’re sending you a cute pin-up of everyone’s favorite Gearhead Girl, Ophelia.

title: Snubby Love - Rank 2
reward_mail_subject: Valentine's: A walk along the Waterfront
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on reaching level 2 in the Snubby Love role! There’s nothing nicer than going with your loved one for a walk down by the Waterfront. That being said, it’d probably be smart to show a Bloodrose symbol so when the shooting starts you’re guaranteed at least be given a little covering fire. With that in mind, we’ve sent you a Bloodrose symbol for your protection.

title: Snubby Love - Rank 3
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on reaching level 3 in the Snubby Love role! We can’t help but notice that Ophelia is something of a pinup around these parts – maybe it’s the smart, funny and powerful business woman thing. Maybe it’s the fact she could kick your ass and look good doing it. Maybe it’s the really tight top. Regardless of the reason, we’re giving you a Naughty Ophelia Pinup for your symbol editor. Enjoy.

title: Snubby Love - Rank 4
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on reaching level 4 in the Snubby Love role! The Colby SNR may have fallen out of favor with both Enforcers and Criminals but it still has a special place in all our hearts. You’ve proven your love for this weapon with your dedication and we’re all about rewarding dedication. You’re now able to purchase the Colby SNR 850 ‘Cherub’ from contacts at any point from now on. Keep the Snubby Love alive.

title: Snubby Love - Rank 5 (Complete)
reward_mail_body: Congratulations on reaching level 5 in the Snubby Love role! We’re sending you the Cherub Chaser since you’re obviously dedicated to Chasing kills with the Cherub pistol. Lots of love, Reloaded Productions.
